Draft — Krea 2 Turbo split-model graph (8-step distilled, CFG 0.0, constant mu=1.15, 1024–2048 px padded to multiple of 16). Node set verified against ComfyUI PR #14589 (v0.26.0+); ModelSamplingAuraFlow carries the mu timestep shift because PR #14589 adds no Krea2-specific sampling node — re-probe /object_info and live-smoke before Certified. ComfyUI KSampler cfg semantics for the official 'CFG disabled (0.0)' convention must be validated at Phase C cert. Weights are gated (Krea 2 Community License) — link an existing download via Source Manager; never auto-downloaded.

Phase C: style/moodboard/character/environment reference images and LoRA controls are wired in the builder (LoadImage + CLIPVision + IPAdapterApply chain, LoraLoader). These require the optionalNodes support set installed on the ComfyUI runtime; the IPAdapterLoader/IPAdapterApply class names follow the standard IPAdapter plugin convention and are UNVERIFIED pending a live /object_info probe.

ERS assets are preserved as ENVIRONMENT conditioning; Krea 2's open ComfyUI path consumes them via a generic reference interface, so the semantic role is carried in Adept metadata pending provider-native role support.
